quotes.text:
Thanks, I just submitted Qubes, my game.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.victorribeiro.qubes

This seems like a nice list to be on; how do I submit my game? It has no ads, no dark patterns...

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.victorribeiro.qubes

Android only for now, but an apple version could be arranged

by the way, this is Qubes, if anyone wants to check out. I've made an nice update, but Google Play haven't released it yet.

The update shows you many moves you've made and how many moves (optimal solution) you have to make on that level.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.victorribeiro.qubes

The update should be out really soon.

quotes.text:
Ever since I released Qubes[1] I wanted to come up with a way of making some money without a lot of ADs or to charge the user to play the game. So this is what I came up with: If you beat the level with 3 stars I don't show you a AD, how about that?!

It's kind of the opposite of pay to win. If you win (with the optimal solution) you don't have to "pay".

Anyway, I hope this catches on and more developers adopt this strategy, and I also hope more people play my game.

[1] - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.victorribeiro.qubes
